item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | Ignite 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry Ignite 2026 introduces updates across agents, developer tools, models, training, enterprise context, and governance. The post also emphasizes continuous improvement.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Governance policy guidance in Foundry Canvas and VS Code
item.description:
Governance policy guidance is now generally available in Foundry Canvas and the Foundry Toolkit for Visual Studio Code. As agents are built, both surfaces show relevant policies for agent types, models, toolboxes, and guardrails, including warnings.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure Policy support for Azure HorizonDB is now available in preview. A new built-in policy can automatically deploy diagnostic settings to help apply governance and observability standards across HorizonDB deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from
item.description:
Enterprise administrators can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to be sourced from plugins or managed settings instead of standalone user or project configuration. This works alongside marketplace restrictions for tighter governance over Copilot customization sources.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management
item.description:
Microsoft Agent 365 integration with Azure API Management is now in public preview. The integration connects centralized governance with runtime enforcement for MCP servers and tools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Enable and disable controls for Microsoft Foundry agents in Agent 365
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry agents can now be enabled or disabled from the Agent 365 governance surface in Microsoft Admin Center, and the feature is generally available. Administrators can control whether a Foundry agent is available for use across the tenant.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Copilot model access update for GitHub Team plans
item.description:
GitHub updated how Copilot model access is determined for users with seats in more than one organization. The change is intended to keep billing and governance aligned.

  • Source: GitHub
